infoPlaceholder.title: Travel & Accommodations
infoPlaceholder.subtitle: Helpful details for our traveling guests

cards.title: Getting There
cards.content: Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI) is located 20 minutes from the venue. Taxis, rental cars, and shuttle services are readily available at the terminal.

cards.title: Where to Stay
cards.content: We have reserved room blocks at Hotel Valldemossa and boutique hotels in Alcúdia. Mention the 'Elena & Lucas Wedding' when booking for preferred rates.

cards.title: Transportation & Shuttles
cards.content: Complimentary shuttle buses will depart from the central meeting point in Palma at 16:00 and return guests at 01:00 and 03:00.

infoPlaceholder.note: Feel free to reach out to us if you need help with any travel arrangements.

rsvp.title: RSVP
rsvp.subtitle: Kindly respond by August 1, 2026
rsvp.description: Please let us know if you'll be joining us to celebrate. Submit one form per guest.
rsvp.deadlineNote: Please confirm before August 1st so we can finalize catering and seating.
rsvp.successMessage: Thank you for confirming! We can't wait to celebrate with you.
rsvp.successDeclineMessage: Thank you for letting us know. You will be warmly missed!
